entries.title: Goodbye Complex Editors. Hello, Milestis!
entries.description: We are officially live. Milestis is here to prove that professional design doesn't have to be difficult. From now on, your focus stays on the story, while we handle the aesthetic.
entries.longDescription: Creating a digital legacy shouldn't feel like a chore. Our initial launch introduces a universal editor with strict, high-performance templates for photobooks and portfolios. Whether you're at an event or on the move, you can now build a complete project in under 5 minutes using just your smartphone.
highlights: Select a professional layout and see your project come to life instantly.
Add atmospheric depth with light rays and textures using drag-and-drop.
Your memories are preserved forever with a unique permanent link.
